content: {"episode_id":"ep-05025","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which SilverBridge denied for lack of precertification. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting, as stated in the ordering note. We request reconsideration of this determination on medical necessity grounds for the outstanding balance of 702.81."}
